blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Image-text alignment serves as a foundation for modern vision-language models (VLMs), yet prevailing training paradigms provide limited supervision for learning how semantic changes correspond across modalities. To address this limitation, we propose a post-training method that learns cross-modal semantic change correspondences through controlled visual and textual variations. Specifically, we introduce a Semantic Difference Alignment (SDA) loss which can align the directions of corresponding visual and textual representation changes. We combine our proposed SDA with pairwise sigmoid matching to jointly learn image-text correspondences and cross-modal semantic changes, encouraging more fine-grained and discriminative visual representations. To support this learning, we construct VarFamily-40K, a dataset of image-text pairs with controlled cross-modal semantic variations. Experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in compositional understanding and downstream classification performance, alongside further gains on multimodal tasks when the adapted visual encoder is integrated into VLMs.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: With the development of VLMs [ 47 , 2 , 10 , 58 , 28 ] , learning semantic correspondences between images and natural language is a central objective of VLM pretraining [ 41 , 16 , 60 ] . Existing approaches, such as CLIP [ 41 ] and SigLIP [ 60 ] , learn these correspondences by matching images with their associated textual descriptions. However, an image naturally contains multiple objects, attributes, actions, and relationships, while a single description typically captures only a subset of them, which limits the performance of current VLMs [ 46 , 48 , 50 ] . A natural approach to enriching image–text supervision is therefore to associate each image with multiple captions, allowing complementary descriptions to capture a broader range of visual semantics [ 21 ] . For example, as shown in Fig. 1 (a), the captions “A dog sitting on the grass” and “A red ball beside a dog” describe the dog’s posture and setting, and the ball’s color and spatial relationship to the dog, respectively.
blocks.zh: 随着VLMs[47,2,10,58,28]的发展,学习图像和自然语言之间的语义对应是VLM预训[41,16,60]的中心目标. CLIP[41]和SigLIP[60]等现有方法,通过将图像与相关的文字描述匹配来学习这些对应. 然而,一个图像自然包含多个对象,属性,动作和关系,而单个描述一般只捕捉其中的一个子集,这限制了当前VLM的性能[46,48,50]. 因此,丰富图像-文本监督的自然方法是将每个图像与多个标题联系起来,使补充描述能够捕捉更广泛的视觉语义[21]. 例如,如图1(a)所示,标题“坐在草地上的狗”和“狗旁边的红球”分别描述了狗的姿势和设置以及球的颜色和与狗的空间关系。

blocks.en: Existing work has explored sampling sub-captions from detailed descriptions [ 62 ] , combining synthetic captions with original web text [ 20 ] , and distributing supervision across sentences in long captions [ 22 ] . These approaches enrich textual supervision by describing complementary aspects of a fixed image, while leaving the corresponding visual content unchanged. Although image–text matching can learn to distinguish fine-grained semantics, its supervision does not directly constrain how a change in visual representation relates to the corresponding change in textual representation. This distinction is particularly relevant to fine-grained visual understanding, where subtle variations in attributes, actions, or relationships can alter the semantic correspondence between otherwise similar images and texts [ 43 ] . We therefore seek to explicitly model corresponding semantic changes across the visual and textual modalities.
blocks.zh: 现有工作探索了从详细描述[62]中取样的子标题,将合成标题与原始网页文本[20]结合起来,并在长标题中将监督分布在句子之间。 这些方法通过描述固定图像的互补方面来丰富文字监督,同时使相应的视觉内容保持不变. 虽然图像 - 文本匹配可以学习区分细纹语义,但其监督并不直接限制视觉表现的变化与文字表现的相应变化的关系. 这种区分与细微的视觉理解特别相关,在这种理解中,属性、行动或关系的细微差异可以改变本来相似的图像和文本之间的语义对应[43]. 因此,我们力求在视觉和文字模式中明确模拟相应的语义变化。

blocks.en: Our approach builds on the intuition that corresponding semantic changes in images and texts can be represented by differences between their original and edited embeddings. Since both changes express the same semantic transition, their embedding differences can be explicitly aligned in a shared space. To this end, we introduce S emantic D ifference A lignment ( SDA ) loss, which makes the correspondence between visual and textual changes an explicit training target. As illustrated in Fig. 1 (b), a change from a red ball to a blue ball should induce a visual embedding difference aligned with the corresponding textual difference. A directional alignment loss encourages corresponding visual and textual embedding differences to follow similar directions, while a margin-based discrimination loss encourages each visual change to align more closely with its paired textual change than with textual changes from other image–text variant groups. We combine SDA loss with pairwise sigmoid matching to supervise both individual image–text correspondences and corresponding semantic changes.

blocks.en: Training with SDA loss requires image–text pairs with corresponding and controlled semantic changes. However, existing multi-caption datasets associate different descriptions with a fixed image and therefore do not directly provide this supervision. To address this limitation, we construct VarFamily-40K , a dataset of image–text variant families linking original pairs to semantically edited counterparts. Each family is created through a targeted caption modification and a corresponding image edit, followed by semantic consistency filtering. Preserving scene content outside the targeted edit helps isolate the visual change specified by the text. For example, the ball-color edit in Fig. 1 (b) should preserve the dog’s posture and the surrounding scene. Together, SDA loss and VarFamily-40K enable post-training that encourages visual representations to distinguish fine-grained semantic differences. Our main contributions are summarized as follows:

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Image–Text Pretraining Objectives. Existing image–text pretraining objectives primarily learn cross-modal alignment by distinguishing matched image–text pairs from mismatched ones. CLIP [ 41 ] and ALIGN [ 16 ] employ contrastive objectives that normalize matching scores across candidate images or texts within a batch, coupling the optimization of different pairs. SigLIP [ 60 ] instead adopts a pairwise sigmoid loss that evaluates each image–text pair without global softmax normalization, achieving better performance at smaller batch sizes than softmax-based contrastive learning. Both objectives assign a score to each image–text pair. When a caption changes from a red ball to a blue ball, the scores indicate which image matches each caption. The training objective leaves open how the displacement between the two image embeddings relates to the displacement between the caption embeddings. Our post-training method retains pairwise sigmoid matching as the base objective and introduces SDA loss to additionally supervise corresponding semantic changes across modalities.
blocks.zh: 图片 - Text Pretraining Goals. 现有的图像-文本预训目标主要是通过区分匹配的图像-文本对和不匹配的文本对来学习跨模式对齐。 CLIP [41] 和ALIGN [16] 采用对比性目标,使一组中候选图像或文本的比对分正常化,将不同配对的优化组合起来. SigLIP [60] 取而代之的是双智的sigmoid损失,该损失在不实现全球软max正常化的情况下评价每个图像的文本对,比基于软max的对比性学习在较小的批量尺寸上实现更好的性能. 两个目标为每个图像 - 文本对齐分配一个分数 。 当一个标题从红球变为蓝球时,分数表示每个标题中哪个图像匹配. 培训目标为两种图像嵌入之间的迁移与标题嵌入之间的迁移有何关系。 我们的训练后方法保留了双智的sigmoid匹配作为基本目标,并引入了SDA损失,以额外监督各种模式的相应语义变化。

blocks.en: Fine-Grained Vision–Language Alignment. Recent advances in fine-grained vision–language alignment have focused on enriching textual supervision and learning more precise correspondences between visual content and language. LaCLIP [ 11 ] uses large language model (LLM)-generated caption rewrites to increase linguistic diversity, while Long-CLIP [ 61 ] extends CLIP to accommodate longer descriptions containing richer visual details. LLIP [ 23 ] learns multiple visual features and combines them based on the accompanying text, allowing different captions to emphasize different aspects of the same image. Other approaches refine alignment at the region or patch level. RegionCLIP [ 63 ] aligns image regions with textual concepts, while FILIP [ 57 ] and SPARC [ 3 ] learn correspondences between image patches and text tokens. DreamLIP [ 62 ] connects sampled subcaptions with relevant image patches, and FG-CLIP 2 [ 54 ] combines detailed captions, region-level alignment, and discriminative supervision. Together, these methods enrich semantic coverage and refine cross-modal correspondences. Their supervision focuses on associating language with existing visual content, without explicitly aligning the representation differences induced by corresponding semantic changes in images and texts.

blocks.en: Learning from Semantic Changes. Semantic changes have been explored in vision-language research to improve compositional understanding and support image editing. For example, NegCLIP [ 59 ] introduces composition-aware hard negatives through textual perturbations, while TripletCLIP [ 39 ] further incorporates synthetic visual negatives to improve compositional discrimination. Some other methods, like Instruct-CLIP [ 9 ] , learn to align representations of changes between original and edited images with instructions, supporting instruction refinement and instruction-guided image editing. Our method instead aligns the embedding differences between original and edited images with those between their corresponding captions, using these paired differences for training.
blocks.zh: 学习语义变化. 在视觉语言研究中探索了语义变化,以提高组成理解和支持图像编辑. 例如,NegCLIP[59]通过文字扰动引入了具有成分意识的硬底片,而TripletCLIP[39]则进一步纳入了合成视觉底片,以改善成分歧视. 其他一些方法,如Instruct-CLIP[9],学习将原始图像和编辑图像之间变化的表达方式与指令保持一致,支持指令的完善和指令引导图像编辑. 我们的方法将原始图像和编辑图像之间的嵌入差异与相应标题之间的嵌入差异相协调,使用这些对齐的差异进行培训。

blocks.en: Our method aims to improve visual representations by learning how semantic changes correspond across images and texts. Rather than relying solely on individual image–text correspondences, we introduce SDA loss to align corresponding visual and textual changes while distinguishing them from changes in other groups. To support this, we construct VarFamily-40K, which provides controlled semantic variations through original and edited image–text pairs. Fig. 2 provides an overview of the proposed approach.

blocks.en: 3.2 VarFamily-40K: Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: 3.2 Varfamily-40K:数据集建设

blocks.en: To provide the corresponding visual and textual changes required by SDA loss, leveraging the progress made by visual content generation methods [ 24 , 51 , 49 ] , we construct VarFamily-40K from COCO 2017 [ 25 ] , following the pipeline in Fig. 2 (a), which consists of targeted caption rewriting, image editing, and semantic consistency filtering. Each image–text variant group follows the structure defined in Sec. 3.1 , containing an original image–text pair and its edited counterpart. Fig. 3 shows example groups from VarFamily-40K.
blocks.zh: 为了提供SDA损失所需的相应的视觉和文字修改,利用视觉内容生成方法[24,51,49]取得的进展,我们从COCO 2017 [25] 构造 VarFamily-40K,在图2(a)的管道中,它包括目标标题重写,图像编辑,语义一致性过滤. 每个图像 - text 变体组都遵循 Sec. 3.1 中定义的结构,包含一个原始的图像 - text 配对及其编辑的对应. 图3显示了VarFamily-40K的范例组.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Examples from VarFamily-40K: original (left) and edited (right) images with corresponding captions.
blocks.zh: 图3 : VarFamily-40K的示例:原始(左)和编辑(右)图像,并附有相应的标题.

blocks.en: (i) Caption rewriting. We use Qwen3.5-9B [ 40 ] to generate c i 1 c_{i}^{1} by replacing one short, contiguous span in c i 0 c_{i}^{0} , preserving all text outside that span. The modifications cover objects, attributes, actions, quantities, and backgrounds. Each replacement specifies a visually observable semantic change. We validate the rewritten caption against the selected span and apply edit-type and contextual checks. The original and replacement spans are then used to construct an editing prompt that specifies the target change and asks the model to preserve unrelated scene content.
blocks.zh: (一) 重新编写说明。 我们使用 Quen3.5-9B [40] 来生成 c i 1 c_{i}^{1] , 在 c i 0 c_{i}^{0} 中替换一个短的,毗连的跨度, 保留该跨度以外的所有文本 。 修改内容包括对象、属性、动作、数量和背景。 每个替换者指定一个可视化的语义变化。 我们对照选定的跨度验证重写标题,并应用编辑类型和背景检查。 然后使用原始和替换的跨度构建一个编辑提示,指定目标更改,并要求模型保存不相关的场景内容.

blocks.en: (ii) Corresponding image editing. Based on the obtained editing prompts, we use FLUX.2 Klein 9B [ 4 ] to generate the edited image x i 1 x_{i}^{1} conditioned on the original image x i 0 x_{i}^{0} . We then apply a pixel-difference prefilter to discard generated images with negligible visual changes.

(iii) Semantic consistency filtering. Finally, to ensure the quality of our VarFamily-40K, we provide Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct [ 1 ] with both images and captions and ask it to evaluate each of the four image–text combinations independently. A pair is considered matching when the image clearly supports the full caption, with particular attention to the modified semantic content. We retain groups in which the original and edited images match their respective captions, while neither image matches the other caption. This filtering yields VarFamily-40K, a collection of image–text variant families for post-training. Further details on dataset construction, filtering procedures, and statistics are provided in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: (三)语义一致性过滤. 最后,为了确保我们的VarFamily-40K的质量,我们向Qun3-VL-8B-指示[1]提供图像和标题,并要求它独立评价四个图像-文本组合中的每一个。 当图像明确支持完整标题时,一对被认为是匹配的,尤其关注修改后的语义内容. 我们保留了原始和编辑的图像与各自标题相匹配的组,而图像与其它标题相匹配的组。 VarFamily-40K是一款用于培训后的图像-文本变体家庭。 关于数据集构建、过滤程序和统计数据的进一步详情见附录A。

blocks.en: 3.3 Post-training with SDA Loss
blocks.zh: 3.3 SDA损失后培训

blocks.en: We adopt a post-training strategy to enhance the fine-grained visual representations of pretrained SigLIP using VarFamily-40K. Specifically, we apply low-rank adaptation (LoRA) [ 14 ] to both the visual and textual encoders, keeping the pretrained backbone parameters frozen while updating the LoRA parameters.
blocks.zh: 我们采取了一项训练后战略,用VarFamily-40K加强经过训练的SigLIP的精细视觉表现。 具体来说,我们对视觉编码器和文字编码器都应用了低级的适应(LORA)[14],在更新LORA参数的同时,保持了预先训练的骨干参数的冻结.

blocks.en: While SDA loss aligns semantic changes across visual and textual representations, it does not directly supervise individual image–text correspondences. We therefore retain the original pairwise sigmoid matching objective [ 60 ] and jointly optimize it with SDA loss to preserve image–text alignment during post-training.

blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.1 详细执行情况

blocks.en: Post-training configuration. We split VarFamily-40K into 27,999 for training, 6,000 for validation, and 6,001 for testing. We post-train SigLIP-So400M/14 [ 60 ] on the training split using LoRA [ 14 ] with a rank of 8 and a scaling factor of 16. The SDA loss parameters are set to λ dir = 1 \lambda_{\mathrm{dir}}=1 , λ margin = 0.5 \lambda_{\mathrm{margin}}=0.5 , and m = 0.2 m=0.2 . The model is trained for five epochs via AdamW [ 31 ] , with a learning rate of 9.375 × 10 − 7 9.375\times 10^{-7} , a batch size of 24 image–text groups, and an input resolution of 384 × 384 384\times 384 . To further assess the applicability of our method, SigLIP-ViT-B/16 is also post-trained with an input resolution of 224 × 224 224\times 224 , a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} , and a batch size of 256 image–text groups.
blocks.zh: 培训后配置. 我们把VarFamily-40K分为27,999个培训,6000个鉴定,6,001个测试. 我们训练后SigLIP-So400M/14[60] 使用LORA[14]进行训练分裂,等级为8级,比例为16级. SDA损失参数设定为 \\ dir = 1\lambda\ mathrm{ dir\ 1, = 0.5\lambda\ mathrm{ margin\ 0.5, 和 m = 0.2 m= 0. 该模型通过AdamW[31]为5个纪元训练,学习率为9.375×10 – 7 9.375\times 10^{-7},批量大小为24个图像–文本组,输入分辨率为384×384384\times 384 . 为了进一步评估我们方法的适用性,SigLIP-ViT-B/16也接受了后期训练,输入分辨率为224×224/224\times 224,学习率为10−5 10−5},批量大小为256个图像文本组.

blocks.en: VLM training. We adopt a two-stage pipeline comprising connector pretraining and instruction fine-tuning, using Qwen2.5-0.5B [ 56 ] , OpenELM-450M-Instruct [ 35 ] , and Qwen3-1.7B [ 55 ] as language backbones. The visual encoder is frozen throughout both stages. For a fair comparison, we use the same 1.8M examples from LLaVA [ 27 ] and ShareGPT4V [ 7 ] for connector pretraining, followed by 688K examples for instruction fine-tuning. Each stage runs for one epoch, with learning rates of 10 − 3 10^{-3} and 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} and global batch sizes of 256 and 128, respectively. All comparisons on the VLM share the same training recipe. Additional training details are provided in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 志愿LM培训。 我们采用两阶段管道,包括连接器预训和指令微调,使用Qun2.5-0.5B [56],OpenELM-450M-指示[35],以及Qun3-1.7B [55]作为语言骨干. 视觉编码器在两个阶段都冻结. 为了进行公平比较,我们使用LLaVA[27]和ShareGPT4V[7]的相同1.8M实例进行连接器预训,然后使用688K实例进行教学微调. 每个阶段运行一个时代,学习率分别为10−3 10^{-3}和2×10−5 2\time 10^{-5},全球批量规模分别为256和128. 所有关于VLM的比较都采用相同的培训方法。 补充培训详情见附录B。

blocks.en: 4.2 Evaluation Protocols
blocks.zh: 4.2 评价议定书

blocks.en: We evaluate our method on compositional understanding, image classification, and multimodal performance to assess fine-grained semantic discrimination and the downstream benefits of our post-training method. Details of the evaluation settings are provided in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 我们评价我们关于组成理解、图像分类和多模式性能的方法,以评估精细的语义歧视和我们的培训后方法的下游效益。 评价设置的细节见附录B。

blocks.en: Compositional understanding. We first assess image–text matching on the test split of VarFamily-40K groups and Winoground [ 43 ] , examining the model’s ability to distinguish subtle semantic differences and generalize beyond our constructed data. Following Winoground [ 43 ] , we report text, image, and group scores, which measure the correctness of image-to-text matching, text-to-image matching, and both jointly, respectively. Since these ranking-based metrics do not capture the magnitude of similarity differences, we additionally introduce the m ean p air m argin (MPM), which quantifies the average similarity advantage of correct image–text matches over mismatched alternatives across the entire evaluation set: MPM = 1 N ∑ i = 1 N [ \displaystyle\mathrm{MPM}=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N}\big[ s ⁡ ( x i 0 , c i 0 ) − s ⁡ ( x i 0 , c i 1 ) \displaystyle s(x_{i}^{0},c_{i}^{0})-s(x_{i}^{0},c_{i}^{1}) (9) + s ( x i 1 , c i 1 ) − s ( x i 1 , c i 0 ) ] , \displaystyle+s(x_{i}^{1},c_{i}^{1})-s(x_{i}^{1},c_{i}^{0})\big], where N N is the number of evaluation groups and s ⁡ ( x , c ) s(x,c) denotes cosine similarity between normalized image and text embeddings in the learned shared representation space.

blocks.en: Image classification. We also evaluate image classification to determine whether the benefits of post-training extend to downstream recognition tasks rather than remaining limited to image–text matching. We consider three protocols with different levels of task-specific adaptation. Zero-shot classification evaluates the transfer of the adapted image–text model without task-specific training, while linear probing more directly assesses whether the adapted visual encoder provides useful features for downstream classification when kept frozen. Full fine-tuning further examines whether the benefits of post-training persist after task-specific adaptation of the visual encoder. Zero-shot evaluation covers ImageNet-R [ 13 ] , CIFAR-100 [ 19 ] , Oxford-IIIT Pets [ 38 ] , Food-101 [ 6 ] , and Flowers-102 [ 36 ] ; linear probing and full fine-tuning use the latter four datasets. We report Top-1 accuracy averaged over three random seeds for the two supervised protocols.
blocks.zh: 图像分类. 我们还评估图像分类,以确定培训后的好处是否延伸到下游识别任务,而不是局限于图像文本匹配。 我们认为,有三项议定书对具体任务作了不同程度的调整。 零镜头分类在没有任务特定训练的情况下评价了改编的图像-文本模型的转移,而线性测试则更直接地评估改编的视觉编码器在保持冷冻时是否为下游分类提供了有用的特征. 全面微调进一步审查在对视觉编码器进行具体任务调整后,培训后的好处是否继续存在。 零镜头评价涵盖ImageNet-R [13],CIFAR-100 [19],牛津-IIIT Pets [38],Food-101 [6],和Flowers-102 [36];线性探测和完全微调使用后四个数据集. 我们报告Top -1的精度 平均在三个随机种子上 两个监督协议。

blocks.en: Multimodal performance. To assess whether the benefits of post-training extend to broader multimodal understanding, we integrate the adapted visual encoder into VLMs and keep it frozen during training. We evaluate the resulting VLMs on ten benchmarks grouped into five categories. GQA [ 15 ] and RealWorldQA [ 53 ] cover visual question answering, with an emphasis on compositional reasoning and real-world spatial understanding, respectively. ScienceQA [ 32 ] and AI2D [ 18 ] test science and diagram reasoning, respectively. MMStar [ 8 ] and MME [ 12 ] both assess visual perception and multimodal reasoning. InfoVQA [ 34 ] , ChartQA [ 33 ] , and OCRBench [ 29 ] evaluate understanding of infographics, charts, and text-rich images, respectively. TextCaps [ 42 ] evaluates image captioning.
blocks.zh: 多式联运性能. 为了评估培训后的好处是否扩大到更广泛的多式联运理解,我们把经过改造的视觉编码器纳入VLM,并在培训期间保持冷冻。 我们按分为五类的十项基准来评估由此产生的自愿升级率。 GQA[15]和RealWorldQA[53]分别涵盖视觉问题回答,强调组成推理和现实世界空间理解. ScienceQA[32]和AI2D[18]分别测试科学和图表推理. MMStar [8] 和 MME [12] 都评估视觉感知和多式联运推理. InfoVQA [34], ChartQA [33], OCR Bench [29] 分别评价对图象,图表,和文本丰富的图像的理解. TextCaps [42] 评价图像标题.

blocks.en: 4.3 Results
blocks.zh: 4.3 结果

blocks.en:
Compositional understanding. Table 1 compares the compositional matching performance of the original pretrained SigLIP (Base) and the same model after post-training with the SDA loss (Ours) on VarFamily-40K and Winoground. On the VarFamily-40K test split, our post-training method improves the group score from 44.74% to 63.06% for SigLIP-So400M/14 and from 49.13% to 63.84% for SigLIP-ViT-B/16.
Since each group contains images and captions differing in a targeted semantic concept, these gains indicate that the adapted models more effectively distinguish correct correspondences from semantically similar mismatches introduced by the controlled edits.

组成理解. 表1比较了原有的预训SigLIP(Base)与训练后相同的型号在VarFamily-40K和Winoground上的SDA损失(Ours)的成分匹配性能. 在Varfamily-40K测试分中,我们的培训后方法提高了SigLIP-So400M/14的组分从44.74%提高到63.06%,SigLIP-ViT-B/16的组分从49.13%提高到63.84%。
由于每个组都包含目标语义概念中不同的图像和标题,这些收益表明,经过调整的模型可以更有效地区分正确对应和受控编辑引入的类似现象。

blocks.en: On Winoground, SigLIP-So400M/14 achieves improvements across all three matching scores, with the group score increasing from 3.75% to 7.25%. These results suggest that the learned semantic-change representations can generalize beyond the controlled variations in VarFamily-40K. Although SigLIP-ViT-B/16 improves only in text score on Winoground, its higher MPM suggests improved average separation between correct and mismatched pairs despite limited gains in ranking-based metrics. Additional comparisons with existing fine-grained vision-language alignment methods are provided in Appendix C for broader empirical context.
blocks.zh: 在Winoground上,SigLIP-So400M/14在所有三个匹配的分数上都实现了改进,组分从3.75%增加到7.25%. 这些结果表明,学得的语义变化表述可以超越VarFamily-40K中受控的变异而普遍化. 虽然SigLIP-ViT-B/16只在Winoground的文字分数上有所改进,但其较高的MPM建议改进对对对对对的平均区分,尽管基于排名的度量有限. 附录C为更广泛的实证背景提供了与现有精细视觉语言校准方法的进一步比较。

Moreover, this example highlights the value of MPM in capturing improvements in matching quality that remain overlooked by ranking-based metrics when the correct rankings are unchanged despite clear increases in similarity margins.

blocks.en: Beyond the matching case study, we visualize gradient-weighted activation maps on VarFamily-40K in Fig. 5 to examine how the visual encoder responds to semantic changes. When the scene changes from a bowl of cereal to a bowl of fruit, our adapted encoder shows more concentrated activations in the regions corresponding to the semantic change, whereas the baseline exhibits more dispersed responses. This indicates that the adapted encoder more effectively identifies visual regions associated with the corresponding textual changes.
blocks.zh: 除了匹配的案例研究外,我们在图5的VarFamily-40K上可视化梯度加权激活图,以考察视觉编码器如何响应语义变化. 当场景从一碗麦片变成一碗水果时,我们经过改造的编码器显示,在与语义变化相对应的区域,激活更加集中,而基线显示的反应更加分散. 这表明,经过调整的编码器更有效地识别了与相应的文字变化相关的视觉区域.

blocks.en: These results suggest that learning corresponding visual and textual changes enhances fine-grained semantic understanding, with benefits beyond the constructed training distribution. More examples are provided in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,学习相应的视觉和文字变化可以增强精细的语义理解,其好处超出了构建的培训分布. 附录D提供了更多实例。

blocks.en: Image classification. As shown in Fig. 6 , both SigLIP backbones achieve consistent improvements across all evaluated datasets under zero-shot classification and linear probing. For SigLIP-So400M/14, zero-shot accuracy on ImageNet-R increases from 46.64% to 58.73%, while linear-probe accuracy on Oxford Pets increases from 62.16% to 87.47%. Notably, the improvements under linear probing, where the visual encoder remains frozen, show that post-training enhances the transferability of visual representations rather than merely improving image–text matching.
blocks.zh: 图像分类. 如图6所示,SigLIP主干线在零射线分类和线性探测下,对所有评价数据集都取得了一致的改进。 对于SigLIP-So400M/14,图像上的零射精度 Net-R从46.64%增至58.73%,而牛津佩茨的线性探测精度则从62.16%增至87.47%. 值得注意的是,线性探测(视觉编码器仍然冷冻)的改进表明,培训后可增强视觉表现的可转移性,而不仅仅是改善图像-文字匹配。

blocks.en: Under full fine-tuning, the original and adapted encoders achieve similar performance, suggesting that task-specific supervision can narrow the differences between their initial representations. Overall, these results indicate that the benefits of learning corresponding semantic changes extend beyond cross-modal matching to the transferability of visual representations, particularly when the visual encoder is reused without full task-specific adaptation.
blocks.zh: 在全面微调下,原版和改编的编码器实现相似的性能,说明针对具体任务的监督可以缩小其初始表达的差异. 总的来说,这些结果表明,学习相应语义变化的好处超越了跨模式匹配到视觉表现的可转移性,特别是在视觉编码器在未完全针对任务进行适应的情况下被重新使用.

blocks.en: Multimodal performance. Table 2 presents the multimodal understanding performance of VLMs equipped with the original SigLIP-So400M/14 visual encoder and our adapted encoder across three language backbones. Replacing the original visual encoder with the post-trained encoder improves multimodal performance, particularly with Qwen2.5-0.5B [ 56 ] and Qwen3-1.7B [ 55 ] , where gains are observed on nine of the ten benchmarks. These improvements span visual question answering, reasoning, document and chart understanding, and text-rich visual understanding.
blocks.zh: 多式联运性能. 表2列出装有原始SigLIP-So400M/14视觉编码器和我们经过改造的三种语言主干线编码器的VLM的多式联运理解性能. 用训练后的编码器取代原来的视觉编码器可以提高多式联运的性能,特别是Quen2.5-0.5B [56] 和Quen3-1.7B [55],其中在十项基准中的九项中观察到了增益. 这些改进跨越视觉问题回答,推理,文件和图表理解,以及文本丰富的视觉理解.

blocks.en: The visual encoder remains frozen throughout both stages of VLM training. The observed gains therefore provide evidence that our proposed SDA loss improves the downstream utility of visual representations, rather than merely enhancing image–text matching. Together, these results demonstrate the potential of semantic-change supervision to benefit multimodal understanding across different VLM configurations.
blocks.zh: 视觉编码器在VLM训练的两个阶段仍然冷冻. 因此,观察到的收益证明,我们提议的SDA损失改善了视觉表现的下游用途,而不仅仅是增强图像文本匹配。 这些结果共同表明,语义变化监督有可能促进不同VLM配置的多式联运。

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.4 阅读研究

blocks.en: We conduct ablation studies to examine the contributions of the visual and textual encoders, the effectiveness of individual loss components, and the influence of training data scale and edit allocation. Additional experimental analyses are provided in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 我们进行开发研究,审查视觉和文字编码器的贡献、单个损失部分的有效性以及培训数据规模和编辑分配的影响。 附录C提供了其他实验分析。

blocks.en: Visual and textual encoder contributions. We investigate the respective contributions of the visual and textual encoders from SigLIP-So400M/14 by evaluating different combinations of their original pretrained and post-trained versions. As shown in Table 3 , using only the post-trained visual encoder improves the group score from 44.74% to 62.87% on the test split of VarFamily-40K and from 3.75% to 8.75% on Winoground, whereas using only the post-trained text encoder yields limited or no improvement. Moreover, using the post-trained visual encoder alone achieves comparable performance to using both post-trained encoders on VarFamily-40K and higher performance on Winoground. These results suggest that the improvements are primarily attributable to changes in the visual encoder, highlighting the effectiveness of SDA loss in improving fine-grained visual representations.
blocks.zh: 视觉和文字编码器的贡献。 我们调查SigLIP-So400M/14的视觉和文字编码器各自的贡献,评估它们最初经过培训的版本和经过培训的版本的不同组合。 如表3所示,仅使用经过培训的视觉编码器,在VarFamily-40K的测试分数上,组分从44.74%提高到62.87%,在Winoground上,组分从3.75%提高到8.75%,而仅使用经过培训的文本编码器产量有限或没有改进。 此外,单使用经过训练的视觉编码器就能达到与VarFamily-40K上使用经过训练的编码器和Winoground上的更高性能相当的性能. 这些结果表明,改进的主要原因是视觉编码器的改变,突出了SDA损失在改进精细视觉表现方面的效力.

blocks.en: Training data scale. Fig. 7 examines how the amount of training data affects our post-training method. As the number of VarFamily-40K groups increases, zero-shot classification accuracy consistently improves across all five datasets, with the full training split achieving the strongest performance. The consistent gains across all five datasets suggest that our method learns transferable visual representations from limited semantic-change supervision, with further benefits from additional training data.
blocks.zh: 培训数据规模。 图7审查了培训数据的数量如何影响我们的培训后方法。 随着VarFamily-40K群的数量增加,所有五个数据集的零镜头分类精度持续提高,全训练分数实现最强性能. 所有五个数据集的一致收益表明,我们的方法从有限的语义变化监督中学习了可转移的视觉表现,从更多的培训数据中得到进一步的好处。

blocks.en: Edit allocation. Table 5 investigates how the allocation of semantic edits across source images affects our post-training method under a fixed budget of 10k generated samples. We compare configurations ranging from 10,000 source images with one edit each to 2,500 source images with four edits each, varying source-image diversity and edit multiplicity while keeping the total number of edits unchanged. Despite these different allocations, zero-shot classification performance remains nearly identical across all five datasets, with less than 0.05 percentage points of variation in average accuracy. These results suggest that our method is relatively insensitive to how semantic edits are distributed across source images, providing flexibility in constructing semantic-change training data.
blocks.zh: 编辑分配。 表5调查了语义编辑在源图像之间的分配如何影响我们在固定预算10k生成样本下的培训后方法。 我们比较了配置,从10,000个源图像,每个源图像一个编辑到2,500个源图像,每个源图像有4个编辑,不同源图像多样性和编辑多重性,同时保持编辑总数不变. 尽管分配款不同,但所有五个数据集的零射线分类性能仍然几乎相同,平均准确性变化不到0.05个百分点。 这些结果表明,我们的方法对语义编辑如何在源图像之间分布相对不敏感,为构建语义变化培训数据提供了灵活性.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we introduce Semantic Difference Alignment (SDA) loss for visual encoder post-training to improve fine-grained visual understanding. SDA loss goes beyond conventional image–text alignment by explicitly aligning corresponding semantic changes across modalities, introducing a complementary supervision signal for learning fine-grained and discriminative visual representations. To enable this learning paradigm, we constructed VarFamily-40K through targeted caption modifications, corresponding image edits, and semantic consistency filtering. Extensive experiments demonstrate improvements in compositional understanding, zero-shot classification, and linear probing across different visual backbones, alongside gains on a broad range of multimodal benchmarks when the adapted encoder is integrated into VLMs. Our findings highlight the value of learning both image–text correspondences and cross-modal correspondences between semantic changes, providing a complementary direction for improving the transferability of pretrained visual encoders.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们引入了视觉编码器后培训的语义差异对齐(SDA)损失,以提高精细的视觉理解. SDA损失超越了常规的图像-文本对齐,明确调整了不同模式的相应语义变化,引入了学习精细和歧视性视觉表现的补充监督信号. 为了启用这个学习范式,我们通过定向字幕修改,相应的图像编辑,语义一致性过滤,构建了VarFamily-40K. 广泛的实验表明,在将经过调整的编码器纳入VLM时,在构象理解、零镜头分类和跨不同视觉主干线线的线性探测方面有所改进,同时在广泛的多式联运基准上也取得了收益。 我们的研究结果突出了学习图像-文本通信以及语义变化之间的跨模式通信的价值,为改进预先培训的视觉编码器的可转移性提供了补充方向。

blocks.en: Although our method demonstrates improvements in compositional understanding, image classification, and multimodal tasks, several limitations remain. First, VarFamily-40K relies on synthetically edited images, which may contain unintended visual changes that are not fully addressed by semantic consistency filtering. Second, our training data focuses on individual semantic changes, and the effectiveness of SDA loss when trained on more complex semantic variations remains to be evaluated. Future work will investigate more reliable data generation strategies and explore semantic-change supervision involving multiple interacting visual attributes.
blocks.zh: 尽管我们的方法表明在组成理解、图像分类和多式联运任务方面有所改进,但仍有一些局限性。 首先,VarFamily-40K依赖于合成编辑的图像,这些图像可能包含意想不到的视觉变化,这些变化没有通过语义一致性过滤完全解决. 第二,我们的培训数据侧重于单个语义变化,在接受更复杂的语义变化培训时,SDA损失的有效性仍有待评估。 今后的工作将调查更可靠的数据生成战略,并探索涉及多种交互视觉属性的语义变化监督.

blocks.en: A VarFamily-40K Construction and Statistics
blocks.zh: 一个40K家庭 建筑和统计

blocks.en: A.1 Construction of VarFamily-40K
blocks.zh: A.1 建造家庭建筑-40K

blocks.en: Data sources and caption rewriting. VarFamily-40K is constructed using images and their corresponding captions from the COCO 2017 training set [ 25 ] . To introduce targeted semantic variations while preserving the original scene context, we use Qwen3.5-9B [ 40 ] to rewrite selected captions by replacing a single contiguous text span. The rewriting process follows the prompt in Table S1 , which specifies the editing constraints and requires a JSON output containing the original span, its replacement, and the rewritten caption.
blocks.zh: 数据源和标题重写 。 VarFamily-40K的构造使用图片及其来自COCO 2017训练集的相应标题[25]. 为了在保留原场景上下文的同时引入有针对性的语义变化,我们使用Quen3.5-9B[40]通过替换单个毗连文本跨度来重写选定的标题. 重写过程遵循表S1中的提示,该提示指定了编辑限制,需要包含原跨度的JSON输出,替换,以及重写标题.

blocks.en: To ensure that each rewrite introduces only the intended textual change, we apply rule-based validation to the generated caption. The original span must appear exactly once in the source caption, and the rewritten caption must differ from the original one only by the specified replacement. Additional checks enforce span-length constraints and exclude comparative or relative-size expressions and unnatural phrases. If validation fails, we retry generation using the same input caption, with up to four attempts at temperatures of 0, 0.4, 0.7, and 0.9.
blocks.zh: 为确保每次重写只引入预定的文字更改,我们对生成的字幕应用基于规则的验证. 原始跨度必须在源标题中准确出现一次,重写标题必须仅通过指定的替换而与原标题不同. 其他检查执行跨长限制,排除比较或相对大小的表达和不自然的短语. 如果验证失败,我们使用相同的输入标题重试生成,最多四次尝试温度为0、0.4、0.7和0.9。

blocks.en: Table S1 : Caption rewriting prompt for Qwen3.5-9B. The system message specifies the rewriting constraints and output format, while the user message provides the original COCO caption and the requested edit type.
blocks.zh: 表S1:Qwen3.5-9B的字幕重写提示. 系统消息指定了重写限制和输出格式,而用户消息则提供了COCO的原始标题和请求的编辑类型.

blocks.en: Image editing. To translate textual variations into corresponding visual changes, we use FLUX.2 Klein 9B [ 5 ] to generate edited images, conditioned on the original images and validated caption rewrites. As shown in Table S2 , the editing prompt specifies the original and replacement spans while instructing the model to preserve unrelated visual content. To satisfy the input requirements of FLUX.2 Klein 9B, image dimensions are adjusted to multiples of 16 while approximately preserving the original aspect ratio. The original and edited images within each group are maintained at the same resolution. We use the default inference configuration (4 denoising steps, guidance scale 1.0).
blocks.zh: 图像编辑. 要将文字变体翻译为相应的视觉变化,我们使用FLUX.2 Klein 9B[5]生成经编辑的图像,以原始图像为条件,并验证字幕重写. 如表S2所示,编辑提示在指示模型保存不相关的视觉内容的同时,指定了原始和替换跨度. 为了满足FLUX.2 Klein 9B的输入要求,图像维度被调整为16倍数,同时大致保留了原来的宽比. 每个组内原始和经编辑的图像均按同一决议保存。 我们使用默认推论配置(4个调试步骤,指针比1.0).

blocks.en: Semantic consistency filtering. Although pixel-level filtering identifies candidates with measurable visual changes, it cannot determine whether these changes correspond to the intended semantic edits. We therefore employ Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct [ 1 ] to assess each candidate group based on the original and edited images, their corresponding captions, and the intended text replacement. The model evaluates whether the edited image supports the full edited caption, with particular attention to whether the intended semantic change is correctly represented. Each candidate receives an acceptance decision and a quality score from 1 to 5 and passes this assessment only if the model returns accept = true with a score of at least 4.
blocks.zh: 语义一致性过滤. 虽然像素级的过滤可以识别具有可测量视觉变化的候选人,但无法确定这些变化是否与预期的语义编辑对应. 因此,我们利用Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct [1] 来根据原始和编辑的图像、其相应的标题和打算替换的文本来评估每个候选组。 该模型评价了被编辑的图像是否支持被编辑的完整标题,尤其关注意图的语义变化是否得到正确反映. 每个考生得到1至5分的录取决定和质量分数,并且只有模型返回接受=真实,且分数至少为4,才能通过这一评分.

blocks.en: Beyond the correctness of individual image–text pairs, VarFamily-40K requires the original and edited states to be semantically distinguishable. An edited image may support its corresponding caption while remaining compatible with the alternative caption, introducing ambiguity into semantic-change supervision. To address this, the model independently evaluates all four image–text combinations within each group. We retain only candidates with the matching pattern ( true , true , false , false ) (\mathrm{true},\mathrm{true},\mathrm{false},\mathrm{false}) , indicating that each image supports its corresponding caption but not the alternative caption. Both the quality assessment and four-way consistency check are performed in a single inference pass at temperature 0, using the prompt in Table S3 .
blocks.zh: VarFamily-40K除了个人图像对文本的正确性外,还要求原始状态和编辑的状态具有可区分性。 经编辑的图像可能支持其相应的标题,同时保持与替代标题的兼容性,从而在语义变化监督中引入歧义. 为了解决这个问题,模型独立评估了每个组内所有四个图像-文本组合. 我们只保留匹配模式( 真, 真, 假, 假) (\ mathrm{ true},\ mathrm{ true},\ mathrm{ false},\ mathrm{ false}) 的候选人, 表示每个图像支持其相应的标题, 而不是替代标题 。 质量评估和四向一致性检查均采用表S3中的速率,在0温度下以单一推论通过。

blocks.en: A.2 Statistics of VarFamily-40K
blocks.zh: A.2 家庭统计-40K

blocks.en: VarFamily-40K comprises 40,000 image–text groups, as defined in Sec. 3.1, each containing an original image–text pair and its semantically edited counterpart. This yields 80,000 image–text pair instances. While each group introduces a newly generated edited image, multiple groups may share the same original COCO image through different caption annotations. Consequently, the 40,000 groups are constructed from 34,442 unique source images, yielding 74,442 images in total, including 40,000 edited images. We further analyze the distribution of semantic variations, report filtering statistics with representative examples, and describe the dataset splits.
blocks.zh: VarFamily-40K包含40,000个图像文本组,定义在Sec. 3.1中,每个组包含一个原始图像文本对及其精密编辑的对应版本. 这会产生8万个图像文本配对实例 。 虽然每个组引入新生成的编辑图像,但多个组可能通过不同的字幕说明共享相同的COCO原始图像. 因此,4万组由34 442幅独特的原始图像组成,共产生74 442幅图像,包括4万幅经编辑的图像。 我们进一步分析语义变化的分布,报告带有代表性实例的过滤统计,并描述数据集的分割.

blocks.en: Semantic variation statistics. We categorize the semantic variation in VarFamily-40K into five types: objects, attributes, actions, backgrounds, and quantities, corresponding to the noun, adjective, verb, background, and quantity edits in the caption rewriting prompt. As shown in Fig. S1 , object edits account for the largest share of groups (43.67%), followed by attribute (28.25%), background (19.75%), action (7.75%), and quantity edits (0.59%). Across the 40,000 groups, we identify 17,732 unique directed text substitutions. Some substitutions recur across different source images, allowing the same semantic change to be represented in distinct visual contexts.
blocks.zh: 语义变异统计. 我们把VarFamily-40K中的语义变异分为五种类型:对象,属性,动作,背景,和数量,对应名词,形容词,动词,背景,以及标题重写提示中的数量编辑. 如图S1所示,对象编辑占组数的最大份额(43.67%),其次是属性(28.25%)、背景(19.75%)、动作(7.75%)和数量编辑(0.59%)。 在40 000个团体中,我们确定了17 732个独特的定向文本替代。 一些替代在不同的源图像之间重复出现,使得相同的语义变化能够在不同的视觉背景下得到体现.

blocks.en: Figure S1 : Distribution of image–text groups across five edit categories. Each bar shows the number of unique directed substitutions and additional occurrences within the category. Percentages below each category indicate its share of the dataset, while those below the bars indicate the proportions of unique substitutions and additional occurrences within that category.
blocks.zh: 图S1:图文组在五个编辑类别中的分布。 每个栏都显示该类别内独特的定向替代次数和额外情况。 每一类别以下的百分比表示其在数据集中所占份额,而栏以下的百分比表示该类别内的独特替代和额外情况的比例。

blocks.en: Filtering statistics and examples. Starting from COCO 2017 images and their rewritten captions, FLUX.2 Klein 9B generates candidate image edits, which undergo pixel-level prefiltering and semantic consistency filtering to construct VarFamily-40K. Pixel-level prefiltering retains 87.70% of evaluated candidates, removing edits with insufficient visual changes. Of the 55,917 candidates evaluated for semantic consistency, 40,000 (71.53%) are retained to form VarFamily-40K. Fig. S2 illustrates representative examples rejected due to insufficient visual changes or ambiguous semantic correspondences, alongside examples that satisfy both filtering criteria.
blocks.zh: 过滤统计和实例。 从COCO 2017图像及其重写标题开始,FLUX.2 Klein 9B生成候选图像编辑器,进行像素级别预过滤和语义一致性过滤以构建VarFamily-40K. 像素级预过滤保留了87.70%的被评审考生,删除编辑时视觉变化不足. 在接受语义一致性评价的55 917名候选人中,有40 000人(71.53%)被保留,组成Var Family-40K。 费格。 S2说明了由于视觉变化不足或语义通信模棱两可而被拒绝的代表性例子,以及满足两个过滤标准的例子。

blocks.en: Figure S2 : Examples illustrating the two-stage filtering process of VarFamily-40K. (a) Pixel-level prefiltering rejects candidate edits with insufficient visual changes, as measured by mean absolute error (MAE) and the fraction of changed pixels. (b) Semantic consistency filtering rejects edits that introduce ambiguous image–text correspondences, even when the edited image receives a high quality score. (c) Examples retained after both stages, where the visual changes correspond to the targeted textual substitutions and distinguish the original and edited semantic states.
blocks.zh: 图S2:说明VarFamily-40K两阶段过滤过程的例子。 (a)像素级预过滤拒绝视觉变化不足的候选人编辑,以平均绝对错误(MAE)和已改变像素的分数来衡量。 (b) 语义一致性过滤拒绝引入模棱两可的图像-文本对应的编辑,即使编辑的图像得到高质量的分数。 (c) 两个阶段后保留的例子,即视觉变化与目标文字替代相对应,并区分原始语义状态和编辑语义状态。

blocks.en: VarFamily-40K splits. We partition VarFamily-40K into training, validation, and test sets at the source-image level. Since multiple image–text groups may share the same COCO image through different captions and semantic edits, we assign all groups derived from the same COCO image ID to a single split. This ensures that the held-out evaluation uses source images not included in the training split, allowing us to assess semantic-change understanding beyond the source images encountered during post-training.
blocks.zh: Var Family -40K 拆分。 我们把VarFamily-40K分为源图像一级的培训、验证和测试装置。 由于多个图像文本组可能通过不同的标题和语义编辑来共享相同的COCO图像,因此我们将来自同一个COCO图像ID的所有组分配到一个拆分中. 这确保了被搁置的评价使用培训拆分中没有的源图像,使我们能够评估培训后遇到的源图像以外的语义变化理解.

blocks.en: B Training and Evaluation Details
blocks.zh: B 训练和评价详情

blocks.en: B.1 Post-training and VLM Integration
blocks.zh: B.1 培训后和VLM一体化

blocks.en: Post-training implementation. LoRA [ 14 ] is applied to the attention output projections and both linear layers of the feed-forward networks in the visual and textual Transformer blocks. We also adapt the output projection and feed-forward layers in the visual attention pooling module. The query, key, and value projections remain frozen. In addition to the LoRA parameters, we update the logit scale and bias used in the pairwise sigmoid objective, allowing the matching logits to be calibrated as the representations change. All other pretrained parameters remain frozen.
blocks.zh: 培训后实施。 LoRA [14] 应用于视觉和文字变形器块中的注意力输出预测和线性向导网络的两层. 我们还调整视觉注意力集合模块中的输出投影和向导层. 查询、关键和价值预测仍然被冻结。 除了LORA参数外,我们还更新了对称sigmoid目标中使用的对数尺度和偏差,使得匹配的对数能够随着表示的变化而校准. 所有其他预先训练的参数仍然冻结。

blocks.en: VLM integration. After post-training, we integrate the adapted visual encoder, including its learned LoRA parameters, into the VLM. The SigLIP [ 60 ] text encoder is not used in the downstream VLM, where textual inputs are processed by the language backbone. Both the pretrained visual encoder weights and the LoRA parameters remain frozen during connector pretraining and instruction fine-tuning, which allows us to evaluate the downstream utility of the post-trained visual representation. The SDA loss and pairwise sigmoid objectives are used only during SigLIP post-training.
blocks.zh: VLM集成. 经过后期训练,我们把经过改造的视觉编码器,包括其学习的LORA参数,整合到VLM中. SigLIP [60]文本编码器不用于下游的VLM,其中文字输入由语言主干处理. 预训视觉编码器的重量和LORA参数在连接器预训和指令微调时都保持冻结,这使我们能够评价后训视觉表现的下游效用. SDA损失和对偶的sigmoid目标仅在SigLIP训练后使用.

blocks.en: B.2 Image Classification Settings
blocks.zh: B.2 图像分类设置

blocks.en: Benchmark dataset splits. Linear probing and full fine-tuning use identical data partitions to ensure consistent comparisons across adaptation protocols. For CIFAR-100 [ 19 ] , Food-101 [ 6 ] , and Oxford-IIIT Pets [ 38 ] , we construct stratified 90/10 training–validation splits from the official training sets while retaining the official test sets. Flowers-102 [ 36 ] follows its official training, validation, and test splits. Zero-shot classification is evaluated on the same official test sets as well as ImageNet-R [ 13 ] .
blocks.zh: 基准数据集拆分. 线性探测和全面微调使用相同的数据分区,以确保适应协议之间的一致比较。 对于CIFAR-100 [19],Food-101 [6],以及Oxford-IIIT Pets [38],我们构建了分级的90/10训练 - 验证分解与官方训练集,同时保留官方测试集. Flowers-102 [36] 遵循其正式训练,验证,测试拆分. 零镜头分类在同一套正式测试以及ImageNet-R[13]上评价.

blocks.en: Zero-shot classification. We use multiple prompt templates to reduce sensitivity to the wording of individual class descriptions. For ImageNet-R and CIFAR-100, we adopt the 80 ImageNet prompt templates from CLIP [ 41 ] . For Oxford-IIIT Pets, Food-101, and Flowers-102, we use five templates per dataset, including dataset-specific class descriptions and variations involving close-up, bright, and cropped photographs. For example, the template a photo of a {}, a type of pet. explicitly identifies the class as a pet. We replace {} with the class name.
blocks.zh: 零拍分类. 我们使用多个即时模板来降低对单个类描述措辞的敏感性. 对于ImageNet-R和CIFAR-100,我们采用来自CLIP的80 ImageNet即时模板[41]. 牛津大学 Pets,Food-101,和Flowers-102,我们每个数据集使用五个模板,包括数据集特定的类描述和涉及特写,亮度和裁剪照片的变体. 例如,模板一个QQ的照片,一种类型的宠物. 明确认定阶级为宠物. 我们用班名代替QQ

blocks.en: Linear probing. We train the classifier on ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -normalized global image features from the frozen visual encoder, assessing how readily the learned representations support classification without task-specific updates to the encoder. The classifier is optimized with AdamW [ 31 ] using a learning rate of 10 − 3 10^{-3} , a batch size of 1,024, and zero weight decay. We use a cosine learning-rate schedule [ 30 ] without warmup.
blocks.zh: 线性探测. 我们训练分类器使用l 2\ell\\\2} —— 常态化的全球图像特性 从冷冻的视觉编码器, 评估如何容易 学到的表示 支持分类 没有任务特定的更新 到编码器。 分类器被优化为亚当W[31],使用10−3 10×3}的学习率,批量大小为1,024,零重量衰减. 我们使用一个余弦学习率表 [30] 没有热身。

blocks.en: Full fine-tuning. For full fine-tuning, we jointly optimize the visual encoder and the same linear classification head used for linear probing. We optimize both components using AdamW, with learning rates of 10 − 5 10^{-5} for the visual encoder and 10 − 3 10^{-3} for the classifier. We use zero weight decay and a cosine learning-rate schedule without warmup.
blocks.zh: 全面微调. 为了全面微调,我们共同优化了视觉编码器和用于线性探测的同一线性分类头. 我们利用亚当W优化了两个组件,视觉编码器的学习率是10−5 10−5}而分类器的学习率是10−3 10−3}。 我们使用零重量衰变 和没有热身的余弦学习率表。

blocks.zh: C 其他实验结果

Text, image, and group scores and classification accuracies are reported as percentages. MPM denotes mean pair margin. blocks.en: C.1 Comparison with Existing Methods
blocks.zh: C.1 与现有方法的比较

blocks.en: To further evaluate our post-training method on compositional understanding and downstream image classification, we compare it with four fine-grained vision–language alignment methods: TripletCLIP [ 39 ] , EQSIM [ 45 ] , NegCLIP [ 59 ] , and FSC-CLIP [ 37 ] . To ensure consistency in the underlying image–text alignment objective, we use the pairwise sigmoid loss for image–text alignment in all methods, replacing the original softmax-based contrastive loss where applicable. The results are summarized in Table S4 .
blocks.zh: 为了进一步评价我们关于组成理解和下游图像分类的训练后方法,我们把它与四种精细的视觉-语言校正方法进行比较:TripletCLIP [39],EQSIM [45],NegCLIP [59],和FSC-CLIP [37]. 为了确保基本图像-文本对齐目标的一致性,我们在所有方法中都使用成对的sigmoid 损失来进行图像-文本对齐,并在适用的情况下取代原先基于软马克思的对比性损失。 调查结果摘要见表S4。

blocks.en: Our method achieves the highest group scores and MPM on both VarFamily-40K and Winoground [ 43 ] , with group scores of 63.06% and 7.25%, respectively. Existing methods improve compositional discrimination through hard-negative supervision [ 39 , 59 , 37 ] or image–text similarity regularization [ 45 ] , but do not explicitly align changes in visual and textual representations. In contrast, our post-training method uses paired edits to enforce the correspondence between visual and textual differences while preserving individual image–text alignment through pairwise matching. The higher group scores indicate more consistent discrimination of these closely related pairs, while the higher MPM reflects greater separation between correct and mismatched pairs. Although FSC-CLIP achieves a higher image score on Winoground, our method obtains higher group score and MPM, demonstrating the benefits of semantic difference alignment for compositional matching.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法在VarFamily-40K和Winoground[43]上都取得了最高的组分和MPM,组分分别为63.06%和7.25%. 现有方法通过硬否定式监督[39、59、37]或图像-文本相似性正规化[45]来改善构成上的歧视,但没有明确调整视觉和文字表述的改变。 对比之下,我们的培训后方法使用配对编辑来强制进行视觉差异和文字差异之间的对应,同时通过配对来维护个人图像-文本对齐. 较高的组分显示这些紧密关联的对子的区别更为一致,而较高的MPM则反映了对子的正确和不匹配的区别更大. 虽然FSC-CLIP在Winoground上实现了更高的图像分数,但我们的方法获得了更高的组分和MPM,证明了语义差异调和对组成匹配的好处.

blocks.en: We also evaluate downstream classification on ImageNet-R [ 13 ] , CIFAR-100 [ 19 ] , Oxford-IIIT Pets [ 38 ] , Food-101 [ 6 ] , and Flowers-102 [ 36 ] . Our method achieves the highest zero-shot accuracy on each of the five datasets. Under linear probing, it ranks first on Pets and Flowers and second on CIFAR-100 and Food-101. Since the visual encoder remains frozen under this protocol, these improvements depend on recognition information already available in the adapted visual features. These results suggest that learning corresponding semantic changes improves the transferability of visual representations, extending the benefits of our method beyond image–text matching.
blocks.zh: 我们还在ImageNet-R [13],CIFAR-100 [19],牛津-IIIT Pets [38],Food-101 [6],和Flowers-102 [36]上评价下游的分类. 我们的方法实现了五个数据集中每个数据集最高的零射精度. 在线性探测下,它在Pets and Flowers上排名第一,在CIFAR-100和Food-101. 由于视觉编码器在本协议下仍然处于冻结状态,这些改进取决于在经过调整的视觉特征中已有的识别信息. 这些结果表明,学习相应的语义变化可以提高视觉表现的可转移性,将我们的方法的好处扩展到图像-文本匹配之外.

blocks.en: C.2 Semantic Difference Retrieval
blocks.zh: C.2 语义差异检索

blocks.en: To examine how well the learned representations capture corresponding semantic changes, we conduct semantic difference retrieval on the VarFamily-40K test split. Unlike conventional image–text matching, which evaluates individual image–caption correspondences, this task directly compares the visual and textual representation differences induced by the same semantic edits. It therefore provides a direct evaluation of the cross-modal correspondence targeted by the SDA loss.
blocks.zh: 为了检查所学的表达法如何很好地捕捉相应的语义变化,我们在VarFamily-40K测试分裂上进行语义差异检索. 与评价单个图像 - caption 对应的常规图像 - 文本匹配不同,这一任务直接比较了同一语义编辑引发的视觉和文字表达差异. 因此,它直接评估了SDA损失所针对的跨模式函证。

blocks.en: For each test group, we compute the visual and textual difference vectors by subtracting the original embeddings from their edited counterparts, following Sec. 3.1 of the main paper. We perform retrieval in both directions: visual-to-textual (V2T), where visual differences serve as queries to retrieve textual differences, and textual-to-visual (T2V), where the query and candidate modalities are reversed. Both directions use cosine similarity for ranking. Each query is evaluated against 100 candidates, consisting of its paired difference from the same original–edited group and 99 differences from other test groups. The correct target is the difference from the same original–edited group; semantically similar changes from other groups are treated as non-matches. Recall at K K (R@ K K ) [ 17 ] is the proportion of queries whose paired target appears among the top K K candidates. We report R@1, R@5, and mean reciprocal rank (MRR) [ 44 ] . MRR is the average, over queries, of the reciprocal of the paired target’s rank.
blocks.zh: 对于每个测试组,我们通过在主论文第3.1节之后从编辑的对应部分中减去原始嵌入物来计算视觉和文字差异矢量. 我们从两个方向进行检索:视觉到文字(V2T),其中视觉差异作为检索文字差异的查询;以及文字到视觉(T2V),其中查询和候选模式倒置. 两个方向都使用余弦相似度进行排名. 每个查询按100名候选人进行评价,其中包括其与同一原编组的配对差异和与其他测试组的99个差异。 正确的目标是与同一原编组的区别;与其他组的类似变化被作为非配对处理. 在K K (R @ K K K ) [17] 中召回的查询比例是其配对目标出现在K K 最高候选人中. [44]。 MRR是对应对等目标等级的平均数。

blocks.en: Table S5 : Semantic difference retrieval on the VarFamily-40K test split. R@1 and R@5 are percentages; MRR is the mean reciprocal rank. Δ \Delta denotes the gain over Base.

As shown in Table S5 , post-training consistently improves all metrics in both retrieval directions. V2T R@1 increases from 64.51% to 76.74%, while T2V R@1 increases from 60.43% to 71.40%. The improvements in R@5 and MRR further indicate that paired differences are ranked more favorably among competing candidates.
blocks.zh: 如表S5所示,培训后不断改进两个检索方向的所有衡量标准。 V2T R@1从64.51%增加到76.74%,而T2V R@1则从60.43%增加到71.40%. R@5和MRR的改进进一步表明,在竞争对手中,配对差异排名更为有利。

blocks.en: These improvements are consistent with the two components of the SDA loss. The directional alignment term encourages visual and textual differences induced by the same semantic edit to align in direction, thereby increasing their cosine similarity. The margin term further encourages paired differences to exhibit higher similarity than competing differences from other groups. The higher retrieval scores in both directions show that the post-trained model more reliably ranks visual and textual differences from the same edit above differences from other groups.
blocks.zh: 这些改进与SDA损失的两个组成部分是一致的. 方向对齐术语鼓励由同一语义编辑引发的视觉和文字差异向方向对齐,从而增加其余弦相似性. 比值一词进一步鼓励配对差异表现出高于与其他组别竞争差异的相似性. 两个方向的较高检索分数表明,经过后训练的模型较可靠地将视觉和文字差异排在与其他组的差异之上的同一编辑中.

blocks.en: Fig. S3 illustrates two V2T retrieval examples involving action and attribute changes. Taking the action example, the visual query represents a person on skis who transitions from sitting to standing. Post-training substantially increases its similarity to textual differences expressing this action change. Among candidates describing the same action change in different contexts, the paired “person on skis” change receives the highest cosine similarity of 0.558, with its retrieval rank moving from sixth to first. This example illustrates that our post-training method enhances cross-modal alignment of semantic changes while preserving the ability to distinguish their specific contexts.
blocks.zh: 图. S3说明了两个涉及动作和属性变化的V2T检索实例. 以动作为例,视觉查询代表着滑雪上从坐姿向站姿过渡的人. 后培训大大增加了它与表达这一动作变化的文字差异的相似性. 在描述不同背景下相同动作变化的考生中,配对的"登上滑雪的人"变化获得最高的余弦相似度为0.558,其检索等级从第六位移到第一位. 这一实例表明,我们的培训后方法加强了语义变化的跨模式协调,同时保持了区分其具体背景的能力。

blocks.en: Figure S3 : Visual-to-textual semantic difference retrieval. Examples are shown for an action edit (a) and an attribute edit (b). Each visual query is computed as the embedding difference between the edited and original images. The top five textual candidates are shown with their cosine similarities, with the paired target highlighted in green and non-matches indicated by red labels. The target’s rank among 100 candidates is reported above each list. Gray parenthetical descriptions distinguish the contexts in which the same textual change occurs.

blocks.en: C.3 Performance Across Semantic Edit Types
blocks.zh: C.3 跨语义编辑类型的性能

blocks.en: To investigate the effect of post-training across different semantic edit types, we separately evaluate matching performance for objects, attributes, actions, quantities, and backgrounds in VarFamily-40K. This analysis reveals whether the overall matching improvement is consistent across different types of semantic distinctions. Table S6 reports the gains over Base together with the number of test groups in each category.
blocks.zh: 为了调查不同语义编辑类型的培训后的效果,我们分别评价VarFamily-40K中对象、属性、动作、数量和背景的匹配性能。 这一分析表明,总体的匹配改进是否在不同类型的语义区分上保持一致。 表S6汇报了基地的增益以及每个类别中试验组的数目。

blocks.en: Table S6 : Compositional matching gains of post-trained SigLIP-So400M/14 over Base for each semantic edit type on the VarFamily-40K test split. The Samples column gives the number of test groups per edit type. All gains are absolute differences in percentage points.
blocks.zh: 表S6:经过培训的SigLIP-So400M/14的构成匹配增益 VarFamily-40K 测试拆分上每个语义编辑类型的基础. 样本栏给出每个编辑类型的测试组数。 所有收益都是百分点的绝对差异。

blocks.en: Post-training improves text, image, and group scores across all five edit types, with absolute group-score gains of 15.75%, 21.64%, 12.03%, 4.55%, and 21.86% for object, attribute, action, quantity, and background edits, respectively. Despite variations in the magnitude of improvement, the consistent gains across all categories suggest that explicitly supervising how visual and textual semantics change together enhances fine-grained semantic discrimination beyond any specific edit type.
blocks.zh: 培训后改进了文字,图像,以及所有五种编辑类型的组分,对象,属性,动作,数量,和背景编辑的绝对组分收益分别为15.75%,21.64%,12.03%,4.55%,21.86%. 尽管改进的程度各异,但所有类别的一致进展都表明,明确监督视觉和文字语义的变化如何共同加剧精细语义歧视,超越任何特定的编辑类型。

blocks.en:
Fig. S4 presents two additional Winoground cases comparing the original and post-trained models.
The first contrasts “Four lions, no tigers” with “No lions, four tigers”.
Both captions contain the same animal categories and count but differ in which category is present or absent.
Base incorrectly assigns the first caption a higher similarity to the tiger image, yielding a margin of − 0.0412 -0.0412 .
Our model corrects this ranking, increasing the margin to + 0.0163 +0.0163 while preserving the other three correct comparisons, achieving a correct group match.
blocks.zh:
图S4提供了两个额外的Winoground案例,比较了原始模型和经过培训后模型.
第一个对照是“四只狮子,没有老虎”和“没有狮子,没有四只老虎”。
两种标题都包含相同的动物类别和计数,但是在哪些类别存在或不存在上有所不同。
基座错误地指定了第一个标题与老虎图像的更高相似度,得出比值为−0.0412 - 0.0412 。
我们的模型纠正了这一排名,将比值提高到+0.0163+0.0163,同时保留了另外三个正确的比较,实现了正确的组比.

blocks.en:
The second case contrasts “Gold for pan” with “Pan for gold”, distinguishing a cooking pan from the activity of panning for gold.
Although the captions contain the same words, their ordering changes the depicted meaning.
Base incorrectly associates the first caption with the gold-panning scene and misranks the captions for the cooking-pan image.
Our model resolves both errors, yielding positive margins for all four comparisons.
Together, these cases illustrate improved discrimination between captions with shared vocabulary but different semantics, suggesting that the benefits of semantic difference alignment extend beyond the controlled edits in VarFamily-40K.
blocks.zh:
第二个案例将“黄金换锅”与“潘换金”作对比,将一个炊具与“黄金换锅”的活动区分开来。
虽然标题中包含相同的词,但是其顺序会改变所描绘的含义.
Base 错误地将第一个标题与 Gold-pan 场景关联起来, 并错误地对 Cook-pan 图像的字幕进行排序 。
我们的模式解决了两个错误,为所有四个比较都带来了正差。
这些案例加在一起,说明在有共同词汇但语义不同的标题之间有更好的区别,表明语义差异对齐的好处超越了VarFamily-40K中的控制编辑.

blocks.en: Beyond image–text matching, we use gradient-weighted activation maps to examine whether the adapted visual encoder responds to the content associated with semantic changes. Fig. S5 shows two examples from the VarFamily-40K test split. In the first example, “playing tennis” changes to “sitting on a bench”, while the tennis-court setting remains unchanged. Base exhibits scattered activations across the fence and other background regions. After post-training, background responses are reduced, with stronger activations around the player and racket in the original image and the bench in the edited image. These responses correspond more closely to the visual content distinguishing the two activities.
blocks.zh: 除了图像-文本匹配之外,我们使用梯度加权激活地图来检查调整后的视觉编码器是否响应了语义变化的相关内容. 费格。 S5展示了VarFamily-40K测试分裂的两个例子. 在第一个例子中,“打网球”改为“坐在凳子上”,而网球场的设置保持不变。 基地展品分散在围栏和其他背景区域。 经过后期训练,背景反应减少,玩家周围的激活力更强,原画面中的吵闹声和编辑画面中的长凳. 这些答复与区分这两项活动的视觉内容相对应。

blocks.en:
The second example changes “eating a banana” to “holding a coconut”, while retaining the monkey and its seated pose.
Both models exhibit activations near the banana in the original image.
In the edited image, however, Base exhibits scattered responses across the animal and surrounding ground, whereas our model concentrates its strongest activations around the coconut and the hands holding it. These observations suggest that post-training enhances the visual encoder’s sensitivity to regions associated with semantic changes within otherwise similar scenes.
blocks.zh:
第二个例子将“吃香蕉”改为“持有椰子”,同时保留猴子及其坐姿。
两种模型在原始图像中都显示出香蕉附近的激活.
然而,在编辑的图像中,Base展示了动物和周围地面上分散的反应,而我们的模型则将其最强的激活力集中在椰子周围,手握着椰子。 这些观察表明,培训后会提高视觉编码器对在其他类似场景中与语义变化有关的区域的敏感性。
